notices.title: Mid-Term Semester Registration & Fee Payment Portal Open
notices.content: Students are advised to complete mid-term registration and clear pending tuition dues before the deadline. Late fees will apply after the designated date.
notices.author: Registrar Office

notices.title: Central Library Operating Hours Extended Until Midnight
notices.content: Library reading halls will remain open until midnight for the upcoming mid-semester examinations. Quiet study zones will be enforced.
notices.author: Library Administration

notices.title: Scheduled Campus Network Maintenance
notices.content: Routine network maintenance will take place Saturday from 02:00 AM to 04:00 AM. Intermittent Wi-Fi disruptions may occur during this window.
notices.author: IT Helpdesk

policies.title: DYPIU Campus Information Security Policy
policies.summary: Guidelines for acceptable use of campus network, accounts, data protection, and cybersecurity compliance.
policies.content: All students, faculty, and administrative staff must adhere to strict password governance, multi-factor authentication, and multi-tenant data privacy regulations...

policies.title: Academic Integrity and Anti-Plagiarism Framework
policies.summary: Policy governing originality of submitted course assignments, research papers, and examination conduct.
policies.content: DYPIU maintains zero tolerance towards academic dishonesty. Submissions containing unauthorized AI generation or uncredited text will be evaluated by the Disciplinary Committee...
